• Constitutional status to Panchayats
• Three-tier structure
• Direct elections to all seats
• Reservation for SC/ST
• At least one-third reservation for women
• Five-year tenure
• State Election Commission for elections
• State Finance Commission for financial review
At least one-third reservation for women

items: Note that elections to Panchayats are conducted by the State Election Commission, not the Election Commission of India.
Minimum 1/3rd reservation for women is a mandatory constitutional provision under this amendment.
The State Finance Commission is responsible for reviewing the financial position of the Panchayats.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The 73rd Amendment accords constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions.
Mandates a uniform three-tier structure and direct elections for all seats.
Provides reservation of seats for SCs and STs, and at least one-third reservation for women.
Ensures a fixed five-year term of office for Panchayats.
Establishes a State Election Commission for conducting elections and a State Finance Commission for financial reviews.
